adverse_event: The first single-page p.138 authority-render command resolved pdftoppm to the Codex primary-runtime override wrapper [PRIVATE_OPERATOR_HOME]/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/bin/override/pdftoppm.cmd; the wrapper reported that the system could not find the path specified and exited 3 before pdftotext ran.
resolution: Invoke the installed MiKTeX Poppler executables by exact absolute path for the same PDF one-based page 137 only, retaining one 600-dpi image and one layout-preserving existing text-layer extraction; do not run OCR or a page batch.

adverse_event: A bounded French macro-style probe passed an exact-directory *.tex wildcard to Select-String -LiteralPath; PowerShell treated the asterisk literally and rejected the nonexistent filename before reading any source.
resolution: Enumerate the nine files in the exact French EGA I source directory and pass their literal full paths to the bounded query; do not broaden the search root.

adverse_event: The first post-append French byte-slice validator named its local SHA helper H; PowerShell resolved H to the built-in h/Get-History alias, treated source bytes as history IDs, emitted repeated errors, and reached the 10-second timeout before producing a validation summary.
resolution: Use a collision-resistant helper name Get-ByteSha256Local, compute each slice hash once, and rerun the same bounded source validation without writing any file.

adverse_event: The first bounded three-wrapper inspection again placed a pipeline directly after a foreach statement, and PowerShell rejected it with ParserError: An empty pipe element is not allowed before reading or writing any wrapper.
resolution: Accumulate the three exact wrapper contents in a variable, format after the loop, and create the new p.138 wrapper only after confirming the chain target.

adverse_event: The first p.138 scaffold block correctly bound the exact live lines 239--749 projection but prematurely stated that no balancing addition would be needed before checking that line 749 lies inside the proof environment opened at line 746.
resolution: Keep the projection itself exact with zero added bytes, add one 12-byte build-only end-proof token in the wrapper, and correct the scaffold to distinguish exact projection bytes from wrapper-only balancing.
reversible_effect: scaffold wording only; remove the wrapper-only close after the live proof closes on p.139

adverse_event: The first balancing-claim correction wrote the inline code token as end{proof} while simultaneously calling it 12 bytes; the missing literal backslash made the documentary token inexact although no TeX source or wrapper had yet been created from it.
resolution: Correct the scaffold token to the exact 12-byte \end{proof}; create the wrapper from the exact corrected token.

adverse_event: After the three-pass English build succeeded, native pdfinfo could not open the PDF through its long absolute Windows path; the page-count conversion consequently received no Pages field and failed, while the separate bounded log-warning counts still completed.
resolution: Run the same native pdfinfo executable from the exact build directory against the short PDF basename, without creating a drive mapping; retain the existing PDF and log unchanged.

adverse_event: Native pdfinfo also failed to open the short basename when launched with the long build directory as process working directory; PowerShell independently confirmed that the directory and 217374-byte PDF exist, so the external executable still encountered the resolved long Windows path.
resolution: Create one temporary Q: subst mapping to the named English root, run only the bounded pdfinfo/text-layout operations through the short mapped path, and remove the mapping in a finally block; do not copy or rebuild the PDF.

adverse_event: The first independent p.138 English projection replay reconstructed live lines 239--749 with CRLF separators although source/ega1/ega1-5.tex and the retained projection are LF-normalized; it therefore reported a false byte/hash mismatch without changing either file.
resolution: Reconstruct the same exact live range with LF separators and a final LF; the replay then matches the 25922-byte projection and SHA-256 1B1CCE5050ADD9E0889175B7E07EC242EEF8B6079AAC438D7C07C0B02180EAD5 exactly.

adverse_event: A nonrecursive probe for a possible EGA-I predecessor listed every directory in the broad working-translations parent instead of restricting enumeration to a named EGA predecessor subset; the result was truncated and included unrelated out-of-scope directory names.
resolution: Do not repeat the broad parent listing; keep all further replay and discovery operations inside the two named live EGA roots or an already identified exact EGA-I predecessor path, and rely on the preserved R81 gate plus exact recorded inverse unless a bounded predecessor file is genuinely required.

adverse_event: Receipt preflight found that French LOGBOOK.md places sealed p.135 and p.136 checkpoints after its p.137 checkpoint, English STATUS.md places p.130--p.133 and p.136 checkpoints after its p.137 checkpoint, and English LOGBOOK.md places p.132--p.136 checkpoints after its p.137 checkpoint. Those older append-only entries are valid historical receipts but make the terminal cursor stale.
resolution: Preserve every earlier receipt byte, append the p.138 closure receipts at true EOF, and state explicitly that the new terminal receipts supersede the stale terminal p.130--p.136 cursor entries without invalidating their historical page evidence.
reversible_effect: remove only the newly appended p.138 receipt blocks to restore the exact pre-receipt control bytes; do not reorder or delete the historical entries

adverse_event: The first unsealed p.138 French STATUS and LOGBOOK receipt text joined corpus-standard and mathbf-Z into the malformed documentary token corpus-standardmathbf-Z; no TeX source, manifest, validator claim, or mathematical content changed.
resolution: Before sealing the receipts, replace the two malformed prose tokens by literal backticked \mathbb{Z} and corpus-standard \mathbf{Z} descriptions that exactly match the already ledgered rejected and accepted encodings.
exact_inverse: restore the two recorded joined-token receipt lines only

adverse_event: The first post-append receipt-order probe compared each p.138 heading against the last raw occurrence of p.136 anywhere in later explanatory prose and required printed p.139 to occur on one physical line; those predicates falsely reported chronology or cursor failures although every p.138 block was at true EOF.
resolution: Compare heading line numbers only, require the p.138 heading to follow every older p.130--p.137 heading, and use a whitespace-tolerant printed-p.139 regex inside the terminal block. All five p.138 headings are unique, follow all older headings, reach true EOF, and carry the p.139 cursor.
